about.title: About Me
about.description: My name is Vepa Begmedow, I am a web developer specializing in creating responsive, functional, and aesthetically pleasing websites. My passion is developing modern web applications that provide excellent user experience and high performance. I strive to make each of my works not only technologically advanced but also convenient, intuitive, and visually appealing.

skills.title: Skills
list: Frontend: HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript (ES6+), React, Vue.js, TailwindCSS, Bootstrap.
Backend: Basic knowledge of Node.js, Django, Laravel, PHP.

Additional technologies: REST API, Prisma ORM, Sequelize ORM.
